_comment: The SF Broadcast episode list.
This file is the single source of truth for the Broadcast player on the
homepage. It is EMPTY because no episode has been recorded and published
yet — there is not one audio file anywhere in this repository. The player
reads that empty list and renders an honest 'nothing published yet' state.
To publish an episode:
1. Put the audio file in  assets/audio/  (mp3 or m4a).
2. Add an entry to `episodes` below.
3. That is the whole process. Nothing else needs editing.
Entry shape:
id       stable identifier, e.g. "e01"
title    episode title
summary  one sentence
src      path relative to the site root, e.g. "/assets/audio/e01.mp3"
type     MIME type, e.g. "audio/mpeg" for mp3, "audio/mp4" for m4a
date     ISO date, e.g. "2026-08-02"
Duration is deliberately NOT a field: the browser reads the real duration
from the file itself. A hand-written duration is a number that can be
wrong, and the previous version of this player displayed exactly that —
three episode titles with invented run times and a progress bar counting
against a hardcoded number, while a synthesiser played tones underneath.
